title: Designed and ran the company's bar-raiser hiring program
summary: I designed and ran the bar-raiser program, which trains experienced interviewers to sit on panels outside their own team and hold one hiring bar. With talent acquisition in each region I ran global inductions for Brazil, North America and Europe, and seven cohorts followed.
what_would_have_happened: Each team hired for itself, with no one holding a common bar.
the_call: Train a pool of independent interviewers and put one on every panel.
what_i_did: Designed the training, ran the global inductions and cohorts with talent acquisition in Brazil, North America and Europe, recorded role-play interview videos and wrote the program material.
what_changed: The new software hiring and assessment process went live globally, and talent acquisition said there was no way it could have worked without me.

quotes.text: I wished to thank you for all that you have been doing regarding the bar-raiser project, all the effort that you are putting into this. There is no way we could make this work without you.
